risks.title: Exit depends on re-leasing vacant retail
risks.message: The stated exit is 'Refinance to a bank once the ground-floor retail is re-leased.' This suggests the retail component is currently vacant, and repayment depends on a leasing event that has not happened. The application gives no detail on leasing progress, a prospective tenant, expected rent or timing. The credit submission must explain this dependency and what happens if the space is not re-leased within the 36-month term.

risks.title: Refinance case not demonstrated
risks.message: The exit is refinance to a bank, but the application does not show that the loan would meet a mainstream lender's criteria at the end of the term. With the ground-floor retail apparently untenanted, current income and serviceability are unclear. The application also gives no income, lease or serviceability information for the mixed-use asset that would let the credit officer test a bank refinance.
